A Little Letter For You

Dear Chinnu,

I don't say it often enough, so let me say it properly today: I'm so grateful to have you as my sister. Not everyone gets a best friend, a partner in crime and a family member all in one person. I did.

I think about our childhood more than you'd guess. The silly fights, the secrets, the laughing until it hurt. We grew up side by side, and somewhere along the way you became someone I truly look up to.

I'm proud of who you've become: kind, strong, funny, and beautifully yourself. I wish you happiness that lasts, success that feels earned, and a year full of experiences worth remembering.

Whatever comes next, I'll be right here. Always.

With lots of love ❤️

— Your Brother
